title: Core Update Spec Executor
description: Download remote OpenAPI spec(s) into committed file(s). Use with cache: false and never as a dependsOn of generate-api.

urls.description: Map of name -> remote spec URL (multiple specs)

specPath.description: Target file for 'url', or target directory for 'urls' (relative to workspace root or absolute)

specPaths.description: Map of name -> target file for 'urls'

headers.description: HTTP request headers. Values support ${ENV_VAR} substitution so secrets are not committed

check.description: Do not write; fail if the remote spec differs from the committed file (CI drift detection)

format.description: 'raw' keeps the response as fetched; 'json' re-serializes JSON with 2-space indent for stable diffs
